item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be hot and generally fine over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Super Typhoon Mawar now over the western North Pacific is expected to move towards the seas east of Luzon in the next couple of days. There are uncertainties in the subsequent movement of Mawar. According to present forecast, there is a higher chance of Mawar turning northwards in the vicinity of the Luzon Strait and Taiwan. Its outer subsiding air will bring very hot weather to southern China early to midweek next week. Showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Besides, there will be swells over the coastal waters.
